references.role: edit target: actual integer native crop, no resize

arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this actual native 1254 x 1254 game-map sand crop; return exactly 1254 x 1254 opaque pixels. Repair the accidental central vertical join around x500..750 where sand grain size, brightness and contrast jump abruptly. Create continuous warm natural sand with the existing fine hand-painted irregular grains and all original pebbles retained in place. Preserve the shoreline, vegetation or stone outlines if any appear, camera, scale and daytime light. Keep the top, bottom, left and right outermost 115-pixel borders visually unchanged, matching original texture naturally through the outer 230-pixel band. The repair should remove the source cut without smoothing away native detail. No new objects, paths, lines, text, margin, blur or resizing.
